title: Aiding soldiers or police officers in acts of mutiny
text:
46. Any person who-
(a) aids, abets, or is accessory to, any act of mutiny by any member of the Police Force, Prisons Service or National Service or any other law enforcement organ; or
(b) incites any member of the Police Force, Prisons Service or National Service or any other law enforcement organ to sedition or to disobedience to any lawful order given by a superior officer is guilty of an offence.
